# Mary Vance

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hopetown Asylum / Over-harbour  <sub>[v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053), [v5 c5 P54](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0054)</sub>
- **Role:** Bound girl / Housekeeper's assistant  <sub>[v5 c5 P54](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0054), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mary-creature  <sub>[v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 c9 P4](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary Vance is a thin, tanned girl with long, lank braids of fair or tow-colored hair. She has a wizened face with a very wide mouth, a snub nose, and a pale freckled complexion. Her eyes are an unusually pale blue with a narrow black ring around the iris, making them look almost white.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P6](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0006), [v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028)_

## Personality

Mary Vance is tough, outspoken, and intensely vain when dressed up, yet capable of hard work and deep loyalty. Having been severely abused in her early life, she has developed a thick skin and a sharp, gossipy tongue, often giving unasked advice or telling wild ghost stories. Despite her defiant, defiant-sounding manner and bad language, she is intensely appreciative of kindness and fiercely defensive of those who treat her well.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P48](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0048), [v5 c5 P58](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0058), [v5 c5 P125](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0125), [v5 c5 P126](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0126), [v5 c8 P44](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0044), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and sharp-tongued  <sub>[v5 c8 P44](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0044), [v5 c9 P4](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0004)</sub>
- Vain about clothes and appearance  <sub>[v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005)</sub>

- Expert cleaner and mender  <sub>[v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044)</sub>

## Goals

- To avoid being sent back to the Hopetown Orphan Asylum or to a cruel guardian  <sub>[v5 c5 P40](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0040), [v5 c5 P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106)</sub>
- To grow up, get married, and own fine clothes  <sub>[v5 c5 P86](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0086)</sub>
- To become a respectable lady  <sub>[v5 c11 P15](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0015)</sub>

## History

Mary Vance ran away from her abusive guardian, Mrs. Wiley, after learning she was to be sent to an even harsher relative. Losing her saved money on her way to Glen St. Mary, she hid in an old barn in Mr. Taylor's pasture for two days without food until the Meredith children found her and brought her to the manse. She stayed at the manse for two weeks, helping with housework while defying Aunt Martha, and became a regular playmate of the Meredith and Blythe children in Rainbow Valley. Following the sudden death of Mrs. Wiley, Una Meredith pleaded with Miss Cornelia (Mrs. Marshall Elliott) to adopt Mary. Miss Cornelia consented, taking Mary into her home, where Mary blossomed under good food, new clothes, and strict discipline, proving herself to be an energetic worker. She continued joining the children's gatherings in Rainbow Valley and eventually settled contentedly into her new life.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P6](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0006), [v5 c5 P16](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0016), [v5 c5 P26](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0026), [v5 c5 P37](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0037), [v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c8 P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 c9 P19](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0019), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c18 P12](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0012)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned at age six after her mother hanged herself and her father cut his throat due to alcoholism  <sub>[v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053), [v5 c5 P55](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0055)</sub>
- Spent two years in the Hopetown Orphan Asylum before being bound out to Mrs. Wiley  <sub>[v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053), [v5 c5 P54](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0054)</sub>
- Suffered severe physical abuse and neglect for four years at Mrs. Wiley's farm over-harbour  <sub>[v5 c5 P34](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0034), [v5 c5 P49](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0049)</sub>

## Quotes

> I'm Mary Vance.  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>

> It's a very fine thing to have enough to eat—I've often wondered what it would be like—but I'm p'ticler about my cooking.  <sub>[v5 c6 P18](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0018)</sub>

> I'll always back you up and defend you—you can be dead sure of that.  <sub>[v5 c8 P40](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0040)</sub>
